historicalWideReview.interpretation: These 172 conditions ran before the final paragraph-boundary fix; they are not claimed as full reruns of the final runtime.

fixed.issue: Short inline RecordText removed block boundaries between AI original/explanation, completed lesson heading/sentence, and desktop improvement status/note.
fixed.fix: Restore parent blocks and existing paragraph spacing in four display files; preserve RecordText data and inline semantics.

regression.after: Both Chromium and WebKit pass short-record bounding-box checks and existing long-record/state/revision checks.

checks: load network failure uses Korean recovery guidance, does not claim saved, and explicit retry recovers
save-and-leave waits for acknowledgment, keeps assessment/drafts on failure, offers backup/retry, and exits only after success
restore blocked during unfinished/completed familiarity and candidate preparation names the available exit action and preserves all state/revision
320/390px at 100/200%: consistent tabs, Korean close name, truthful settings, no horizontal overflow, axe and state/revision unchanged

real saved history: mobile cards and desktop table disclose complete long meanings/sentences/notes and original AI input/suggestion/explanation with one caution/provider, without modifying state or revision
completed lesson replay also discloses the original meaning, sentence and notes without a write
short records: original/AI explanation without correction, replay heading/sentence, and desktop improvement/note keep separate lines without any state or revision write
isolated real components: reload explains unsaved/busy guards; keyboard disclosure restores every original character safely
anonymous first visit has truthful sign-in guidance, no saved claim, and preserved source/license links
limitations: Browser emulation, not a physical iPhone or VoiceOver
Synthetic accounts, no production learner data or real AI
